query: How frequently in 2026 has Russia launched overnight drone barrages against Ukraine exceeding 600 drones in a single night? List specific dates and drone counts for the largest barrages in May, June, and early July 2026 according to Ukrainian Air Force figures.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of my findings on Russia's large overnight drone barrages against Ukraine in the May–early July 2026 window:

## Key Findings

**Important distinction:** Many high drone-count reports in this period were actually *Ukraine attacking Russia* (e.g., the ~660-drone attack on June 26, 2026). This report isolates only **Russia→Ukraine** barrages per Ukrainian Air Force figures.

**Nights where Russia's drone-only count clearly exceeded 600:**

| Date (night of) | Drones | Missiles | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **May 13–14, 2026** | ~675 Shahed | 56 | ~731 overnight | Part of record 30-hr, 1,600+ munition assault; largest of the war to that point |
| **June 1–2, 2026** | **656** | 73 | 729 | Clearest single-night 600+ case; 22 killed, Kyiv main target |

**At the threshold (exactly 600):**
- **May 23–24, 2026:** 600 drones + 90 missiles (~690 total)

**Below 600 drones (early July — notable de-escalation):**
- July 1–2, 2026: 496 drones + 74 missiles (570 total; "night of horror," 31 killed in Kyiv)
- July 8–9, 2026: 94 drones + 2 missiles
- July 11–12, 2026: 115 drones + 13 missiles

## Bottom Line
The frequency of Russian 600+ **drone-only** nights against Ukraine in this specific window was **low — roughly 1–2 confirmed** (May 13–14 and June 1–2), with May 23–24 sitting exactly at 600. The very largest barrages were concentrated in mid-May, followed by a marked drop in drone volume during early-to-mid July 2026. 

Two important caveats: (1) Ukrainian Air Force reports combine "drones + missiles," so several nights that "exceed 600 total munitions" still fall below 600 *drones*; and (2) the all-time single-night record of 728 drones/741 total munitions occurred on **July 9, 2025** — not 2026.

key_facts: May 13–14, 2026: Russia's overnight strike (May 14, 6pm–8am) used ~675 Shahed-type drones plus 56 missiles, part of a record 30-hour, 1,600+ munition assault — the largest of the war to that point (Ukrainian Air Force).

June 1–2, 2026: Russia launched 656 drones + 73 missiles (729 total); air defense downed 602 drones and 40 missiles; at least 22 killed, 130+ injured — the clearest single-night case of drone-only count exceeding 600 in the window.
May 23–24, 2026: Russia launched ~690 aerial weapons = 600 drones + 90 missiles (some reports 649 drones/55 missiles); at least 4 killed; Kyiv main target — drone count at, not above, 600.
July 1–2, 2026: Russia launched 570 total = 496 drones + 74 missiles; did NOT exceed 600 drones; at least 31 killed in Kyiv ('night of horror').
July 8–9, 2026: only 94 drones + 2 ballistic missiles (72 downed) — far below 600.
July 11–12, 2026: 115 drones + 13 missiles (128 total, 102 downed) — below 600.
Frequency of 600+ drone-only nights (Russia→Ukraine) in May–early July 2026 was low: roughly 1–2 confirmed (May 13–14, June 1–2), with May 23–24 at the threshold.
Many high drone-count reports in this period (e.g., ~660 drones on June 26, 2026) were UKRAINE attacking RUSSIA, not Russia attacking Ukraine — a frequent source of confusion.
The all-time single-night record of 728 drones (741 total munitions) occurred July 9, 2025, not 2026.
Early-to-mid July 2026 showed a marked de-escalation in Russian drone volume against Ukraine compared with mid-May and early June.
